subject: Follow-up: quantify regional premium + next steps (US vs EU residency)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Petrova <elena@greensight.ai>
Cc:  
Date: 2026-03-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from today's discovery — regional cost impacts and next data points

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from my side and the two asks that will let us produce a scoped estimate for both US and EU deployments.

Recap (call highlights):
- GreenSight use case: real-time insights on incoming financial feeds + user-facing summarization (median seq len ~350 tokens when including context).
- Expected steady-state volume: 80M–160M tokens/month; burst to ~350M tokens in peak months.
- Target unit economics discussed: your team indicated desire for ~ $25–$40 per 1M tokens (target depends on SLA/residency).
- Preferred residency: EU-first (GDPR, customer contract), but open to hybrid (EU for PII, US for non-PII workloads).

Two asks (helps us size pricing + infra premium):
1) Cookie-cutter monthly token profile: by day-of-week and by hour-of-day (or a 7x24 hourly histogram) — can be anonymized.
2) Current expectation on contract/budget cadence: target monthly spend band and preferred commitment term (monthly, 12m, 24m). You mentioned budget "mid five figures" monthly; if you can confirm a range that helps us recommend Dedicated vs Hosted.

What I'll deliver once we have those:
- A short estimate comparing US-hosted vs EU-hosted unit costs, including the typical EU premium we see (~12–20% depending on instance/region), and the recommended model/quantization profile for your sequence mix.
- A proposed mutual action plan + trial plan (canary with 2M tokens/day for 14 days) and a draft SLA commitment options.

Attachments: a quick draft pricing explainer (redwood-pricing-estimate-v1.pdf) and a M A P template (mutual-action-plan-greenSight.docx).

Proposed next steps: if you can drop the hourly token histogram and confirm a target monthly budget range by EOD Wed we'll turn around a scoped estimate by Fri.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Diego — that recap is accurate. A couple clarifications and answers:

1) Token profile: we attached a lightweight CSV to the procurement thread but for privacy reasons I pasted a 7x24 summary below (avg tokens/hour). Peak windows are 14:00–17:00 CET. Median seq length including context = 340–380 tokens.
2) Budget: conservative pilot budget = $12k–$18k/month. If quality and latency meet expectations we can scale to $40k–$90k/month within 6–9 months. The finance team prefers an annual commit for pricing predictability if we go beyond pilot.
3) Unit economics target: our product team wants to get close to ~$30/1M tokens in production (EU-hosted). They understand that low-latency US regions might be slightly cheaper.
4) Residency: GDPR requires primary datastore and inference for EU customers to be in EU. Non-customer PII can be routed to US. We'll need evidence of data residency controls (audit log sample + SOC2 statement).

Procurement contact is cc'd (procurement@greensight.ai) — they'll coordinate contract milestones.

Elena
VP Product, GreenSight Analytics

Forwarding Elena's note into procurement and looping Marissa (AE lead) and Rishi (pricing/solutions) to size the EU delta and propose a path.

Marissa/Rishi — two quick asks:
- Can you confirm typical EU premium range for Dedicated vs Hosted for workloads with 300–400 token sequences? Assume target 30–80M steady state tokens/month (pilot to early production).
- Please model two scenarios: (A) EU-only inference (all traffic in EU) and (B) Hybrid routing (EU for PII, US for non-PII). Include both: 1) $/1M token for each region and 2) projected monthly bill for 80M and 200M token volumes.

I've attached the draft pricing explainer. Elena — procurement asked if we can put a short mutual action plan on paper; attached MAP draft too.

Thanks — Diego

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, GreenSight Analytics Procurement <procurement@greensight.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Elena Petrova <elena@greensight.ai>
Date: 2026-03-21T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Follow-up from today's discovery — pricing delta & residency questions

Thanks for the context, team — quick readout from pricing: we expect an EU premium of ~15% on average for Hosted and ~18–22% for Dedicated (due to reserved capacity and regional infra ops) for the instance families that match 300–400 token sequences. That maps to the following indicative numbers (ballpark, exact depends on model/quantization):

Indicative unit economics (illustrative):
- US Hosted: $22 per 1M tokens
- EU Hosted: $25.30 per 1M tokens (~15% premium)
- US Dedicated (committed): $18 per 1M tokens (12m commit)
- EU Dedicated (committed): $21.50 per 1M tokens (~19% premium)

Monthly bill examples:
- 80M tokens/mo: US Hosted ~$1,760 | EU Hosted ~$2,024 | US Dedicated ~$1,440 | EU Dedicated ~$1,720
- 200M tokens/mo: US Hosted ~$4,400 | EU Hosted ~$5,060 | US Dedicated ~$3,600 | EU Dedicated ~$4,300

Next steps we propose:
1) Diego — send the hourly token histogram and confirm whether PII tagging will be at the application layer (preferred) or must be enforced by the inference layer.
2) Elena/procurement — if the pilot budget sits in the $12k–$18k band, we recommend starting with EU Hosted canary (14 days, 2M tokens/day) to validate latency & quality. If you commit to a 12m minimum, we'll run dedicated pricing and deeper discounts.
3) Rishi/solutions — I'll work with you to produce a one-page formal estimate and an updated MAP we can sign off.

Attachments: I'll push a cleaned pricing delta PDF and a MAP version with milestones by EOD Thurs.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
